name: DeFiAI
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Rug pull occurred in the DeFiAI project, and the contract deployer made a profit of about 40 million US dollars. According to SlowMist MistTrack analysis, funds have been transferred to Fixedfloat and MEXC.

descriptions.text: Rug pull occurred in the DeFiAI project, and the contract deployer made a profit of about 40 million US dollars. According to SlowMist MistTrack analysis, funds have been transferred to Fixedfloat and MEXC.

"Our contract has been hacked and has caused a lot of losses," wrote DeFiAI simply in their announcement. That same day, the project had announced the launch of a new website for their project. The total funds stolen appear to be around $4.17 million, according to analysis by SlowMist.
